records.meetingDescription: A special Gram Sabha meeting was scheduled for 26 January 2026 on the occasion of Republic Day. The meeting was scheduled for 10:30 AM at the Zilla Parishad School Ground, beside the flagpole.
records.decisionDescription: The key agenda items included preparation and approval of the GPDP (Gram Panchayat Development Plan) for 2026–27, a special discussion on Republic Day, selection of beneficiaries for individual benefit schemes and reading of resolutions passed by the Mahila Gram Sabha.
